oldSaliceAssertions.ki_reg_isi_salice_context: The Salice Salentino consortium describes Negroamaro as a central local grape and the sea as moderating climate. This provides a setting for comparison within Salento without treating all coastal and inland vineyards as identical.
oldSaliceAssertions.ki_reg_isi_salice_styles: The consortium describes structured, tannic red Salice Salentino and a lighter rosato expression. Compare colour, tannin and intended style in the actual wines; these descriptions do not grade all reds above all rosatos.
